# Current Contract Fixtures

Fixtures are synthetic current-contract examples. They contain no verified market facts, user quotes, external validation, product viability, or recommendation evidence.

`contracts/` and `schemas/` cover the current Manifest, Envelope, Document Bundle, policy, planning, hash, and typed-reference boundaries. `g1.*` covers Assessment planning, branch/fan-in semantics, adaptation, audit/review, reporting, immutable replay, and recovery. `g2.*` covers Discovery maps, candidates, synthesis, enrichment, evaluation, reporting, publication, and recovery. `g3/` covers AI baseline/economics/mandatory coverage and consumer binding. `g4/` covers repository integration with synthetic caller-provided bytes.

Positive and negative fixtures are retained for current producer/consumer semantics. Fixtures that only preserve retired bundle, adapter, old-Run, or frozen historical bytes are not part of the test contract. Historical revisions inside the same current Run remain covered wherever they prove immutable lineage, exact replay, checkpoint/reopen, or crash recovery.
